# truenas_reporting_exporter (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS reporting exporter by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the reporting exporter to look up.

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (Attributes) GRAPHITE exporter settings (the only exporter type TrueNAS currently supports). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this exporter is enabled and active.
- `id` (Number) Numeric reporting exporter ID.

<a id="nestedatt--attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes`

Read-Only:

- `buffer_on_failures` (Number) Number of updates to buffer when the Graphite server is unavailable.
- `destination_ip` (String) IP address of the Graphite server.
- `destination_port` (Number) Port number of the Graphite server.
- `matching_charts` (String) Pattern to match charts for export (supports wildcards).
- `namespace` (String) Namespace to organize metrics under.
- `prefix` (String) Prefix to prepend to all metric names.
- `send_names_instead_of_ids` (Boolean) Whether to send human-readable names instead of internal IDs.
- `update_every` (Number) Interval in seconds between metric updates.
